description:
Updates only the fields present in the body of the scheduling of an invoice that is
**already** `SCHEDULED` — same convention as `PATCH …/{invoice_id}` on the invoice
itself. Unlike the `PUT`, this never creates a scheduling: an invoice that is not
scheduled answers `404`, it is not programmed by this call.

- **`scheduled_for`:** moves the date. If `generation_mode` is not sent, the mode
  already scheduled is kept.
- **`generation_mode`:** changes the mode. If `scheduled_for` is not sent, the date
  already scheduled is kept.
- At least one of the two fields is required; an empty body is rejected with `422`.
- **Availability:** requires the `scheduled_invoices` feature, same as the `PUT`.

BeeL API endpoint: PATCH /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/schedule (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

⚠️ Read before calling:
- Fiscal rules, domains lifecycle: beel_rules_list with domain, or resource beel://guardrails/<domain>.
- The status names, the proforma lifecycle, and which tool performs each operation. (resource: beel://guardrails/invoice-state-machine)

GenerationAction.description:
Action to perform when processing a scheduled invoice:
- DRAFT: Create as draft for manual review
- ISSUE_AND_SEND: Issue and send automatically via email

PatchInvoiceScheduleRequest.description:
Partial update of the scheduling of an invoice that is **already** scheduled — same
convention as `PATCH …/{invoice_id}` on the invoice itself (RFC 9110 §9.3.4 PATCH):
only the fields present in the body are applied, the rest keep their current value.

Unlike the `PUT`, this never creates a scheduling: it is a move, not a replace. At
least one of the two fields is required — an empty body is rejected with `422`.

generation_mode.description: New generation mode. If omitted, the currently scheduled `scheduled_for` is kept.

scheduled_for.description:
New date on which the invoice should be processed. Today or later; an earlier date
is rejected with `422 SCHEDULED_DATE_IN_PAST`. If omitted, the currently scheduled
`generation_mode` is kept.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

name: beel_patch_invoice_schedule
